summary:
➢ PMP-Certified Technical Project Manager with over 8 years of hands-on
experience delivering enterprise-grade IT, Cloud, and eCommerce
solutions, including 4+ years in senior leadership roles driving full-lifecycle
project delivery across Agile, Scrum, and SDLC frameworks.
➢ Proven success in leading and coll aborating with cross-functional
international teams across software development, QA, UX/UI, and business
analysis to architect and deliver complex digital ecosystems, including
custom eCommerce platforms (Shopify Plus, WooCommerce, Custom).
➢ Demonstrated expertise in cloud infrastructure setup, architecture design,
and environment implementation across AWS and Azure, involving server
provisioning, CI/CD deployment pipelines, load balancing, auto-scaling, and
security configuration for high-performance applications.
➢ Skilled in end-to-end delivery—from requirements workshops, BRD/FRD
creation, user stories, and acceptance criteria to sprint planning, resource
allocation, QA/UAT oversight, and post-launch performance optimization.
➢ Adept at cloud-based migration and modernization, backend optimization,
and API integration, leveraging best practices to ensure scalability, security,
and cost efficiency across multi-environment deployments.
➢ Experienced in managing offshore and vendor teams, driving process
automation, and implementing risk-aware project governance that
enhances efficiency, budget accuracy, and stakeholder confidence.
➢ Recognized for fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture
while maintaining strict adherence to quality assurance, compliance, and
documentation standards throughout the project lifecycle.
